title: Table 4: SAE-LEACE against displacement-matched PCA

conventions.fold_combination: within-seed: mean of fold AUCs; retrieval hits pooled over folds
conventions.difference: paired by seed, then mean and sample SD of the per-seed differences
conventions.ood_interval: saved 95% paired query bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 0

caption:
\textbf{Erasure extent: SAE-LEACE against PCA matched in displacement.}
Per setting (E5-small unless marked; seeds 0--4), SAE-LEACE at $N{=}32$ and PCA removal at the smallest rank $r^{*}$ whose normalized squared training displacement reaches SAE-LEACE's (Displ.: that displacement, mean over fits). PCA $-$ SAE is the per-seed paired difference with its 95\% $t$-interval over seeds. Utility is R@10, and topic purity for CAP. Both maps of a seed are fitted on the same split and audited on the same held-out documents. The first two rows are rows A1 and C1 of Table~\ref{tab:mechanism-controls}. As there, the SAEs are fitted separately from those of Table~\ref{tab:primary-id} (same recipe, seeds and splits), so the SAE column differs from that table's SAE-LEACE by .021 on SCOTUS (3 sources) with MiniLM and by at most .003 elsewhere.
notes: SAE column minus Table 2's SAE-LEACE linear AUC: swiltra_de_fr_it/e5-small +0.0010; scotus_oyez_lexis_wiki/e5-small -0.0001; semeval/e5-small +0.0031; cap/e5-small +0.0005; fedlex_domestic/e5-small +0.0022; scotus_oyez_lexis_wiki/mini -0.0207
